scenario.title: Unexpected Change in Band Practice
scenario.context: A community center during an evening band practice
scenario.description: The local band is in the middle of their regular practice at the community center for an upcoming charity concert. Suddenly, the power goes out, causing all the electric instruments to shut down. The band needs to continue practicing but has to adapt to the new situation.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Calm, rational and adaptive. Always looks for solutions and is open to changes.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Maintains composure under stress, adapts to unexpected changes, and collaborates with others to solve problems.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Easily stressed by unexpected changes, prefers to stick to the plan, and struggles to adapt to new situations.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Reacts negatively to unexpected changes, becomes defensive and argumentative, avoids taking responsibility in problem-solving.
